text: Which ZFC axiom guarantees that for a set $x$ and a formula $\phi$, the collection $\{z \in x \mid \phi(z)\}$ is itself a set?
explanation: Separation (a schema, one instance per $\phi$) forms the definable subset $\{z \in x \mid \phi(z)\}$ of an EXISTING set $x$. Power Set produces $\mathcal{P}(x)$; Replacement returns the image of a set under a functional formula (possibly larger than $x$); Pairing builds $\{x,y\}$. Only Separation carves out definable subsets.
